propositions: The import-linter job in _optionality.yml does no unique work because its 9 tests already run in all four test matrix cells, so it wastes a concurrent slot against the org-wide 20-job cap.
The deletion is safe because the import-leak tests are robust in loaded workers: they use freshly spawned subprocesses, pure ast.parse walks, and the module-evicting block_extra fixture.

Deleting the job creates a gap: neither test_ci_workflow_parity.py nor check_verify_gate_parity.py can see inner _optionality.yml jobs, so nothing guards that the 9 optionality tests keep running once the dedicated job is gone.
A durable collection-guard test is added asserting the two optionality files collect exactly 9 items under the default selection, failing if any excluding marker is later added.
The stale check context 'import-linter (no module-scope heavy imports)' in main-protection.snapshot.json must be removed so emergency rollback does not demand a check that no longer exists.
